item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: OS-level dependency support via containers for Azure Functions Flex Consumption
item.description:
Azure Functions Flex Consumption now has preview support for OS-level dependencies via containers. This lets apps extend the Microsoft-managed worker environment with native executables and system libraries.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview
item.description:
GitHub Actions workflow dependency lockfiles are now in public preview for GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, Team, and Free plans. They let workflows pin dependencies more reliably even if tags or branches later move.

  • Source: GitHub
